text: ok... so I'm going to give 5 stars there for referencing and to promote your app because there is plenty of great value waiting to be used there. However, in it's current state, your app isn't good... for instance the first few things you see. In the assessment, multiple choice questions are... well single choices. speaking of which, the choices are somewhat weird... at least for the ADHD thing. anyway, lots to fix and improve but also LOTS of Potential ! lots of love lad or lass ! Cheers
author: Aubrey Gardegaront
developer_reply: Thanks a lot for the honest feedback and support! We really appreciate you pointing out those issues. We’ve already fixed the onboarding and assessment flow, including the multiple-choice questions, and made improvements to the ADHD section. Your input helps us keep improving glad you see the potential and hope you enjoy the updated version!
